lines.en: Wings spread, I skim the ridge.
The mountain wind lifts me higher.
My talons touch ground just once.
I circle along the cliff face.
My steps leave shallow prints in the snow.
Ice clings to my feathers.
The air up high is the cleanest.
I don't walk flat ground; I borrow wind.
My shadow sweeps ahead of me.
Half eagle, half lion — my footing is sure.
The pine tops are right beneath me.
I fly low to check the valley.
My wings rasp against the stone.
One beat and I'm out of sight.
When the wind dies, I glide.
The stones below me tremble.
I perch on the highest stone.
I preen the down under my wings.
My talons grip the rock seam.
The wind ruffles my feathers backwards.
I hold still like a statue.
My lion's tail sways slowly.
The view is perfect from here.
I squint; the sun is bright.
Clouds drift beneath my wings.
I'm waiting for something slow.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出低低的咕噜。
lines.en: A low trill rumbles in my throat.
Snow has gathered in my feathers.
I hear movement down the slope.
A tail sweep knocks off the gravel.
No hurry; from the sky I see everything.
My wings stay folded, ready to open.
You're standing on my mountain.
I cock my head, eyes bright.
Your cloak whips in the wind.
I'm only watching; not decided yet.
We stare at each other through the wind.
No bow in your hands — good.
My talons are thicker than your arm.
This airspace is mine.
My feathers are all on end.
Can you fly? No, you can't.
I shriek in pain.
My feathers are all in disorder.
My wing is pinned; I can't fly.
I stumble backwards.
That one reached the bone.
I growl, tail straight up.
Blood stains my chest down.
I can still fly — don't rush.
I'm watching for a chance to strike back.
I land unsteadily and sway.
Leave that meat on the rock.
I don't eat grass; don't offer any.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西晃得我心痒。
lines.en: That thing in your hand tempts me.
Toss it; I'll catch it myself.
Three steps away, no closer.
I lower my head, then lift it.
I scrape my talons on the ground.
It smells good, and suspicious.
Set it down and leave; I'll come for it.
I circle once before landing.
Wings half open, ready to bolt.
One bite carries me a day.
Don't think I'm foolish.
I cry out first, to startle you.
Is this meat fresh?
If I eat yours, I owe you.
A tail sweep shoves you aside.
The mountainside rings as we collide.
I step back, talons gouging deep.
Don't grab at my back.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞偏了方向。
lines.en: That knocked me off my line.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的胸骨。
lines.en: Your shoulder meets my breastbone.
Break apart and we both fly off.

lines.zh: 撞我？这片山地是我的跑道。
lines.en: Bump me? These mountains are my runway.
Two gryphons, one sky.
We stand side by side on the cliff.

lines.zh: 你理我的颈羽，我理你的。
lines.en: You preen my neck; I preen yours.
Only nestmates come this close.
Wing against wing — that's the vow.

lines.zh: 山风会把我们的味道带走。
lines.en: The wind will carry our scent away.
We guard this nest together.
You take the left; I take the right.

lines.zh: 爪子在石上刻同一道痕。
lines.en: Our talons score the same mark.
No one else in the sky — perfect.
I snatch up a bright stone.
My talons close on your thing.
I'll carry off this iron.
I peck at it once.
It's heavier than I expected.
I drop it into the nest.
Shiny things belong in the nest.
I pin it so it won't roll.
So small — gone in one bite.
I carry it through two circles of flight.
You moved; I saw it.
Wings open — I'm coming down.
The target is the one running fastest.

lines.zh: 我从高处看得一清二楚。
lines.en: From up here I see it all.
Dive first, then raise the talons.
There's nowhere to hide on this mountain.
I've locked onto your direction.
Don't look up — it's too late.
I shriek and plunge.
My shape is already in your shadow.
One circle past, then another.
Wherever you run, I follow.
The wind holds me high.
Talons tucked, ready to open.
Hiding in the trees won't help.

lines.zh: 我贴着山脊滑下来，翅膀不扇。
lines.en: I glide down the ridge without a single wingbeat.
One more pass and I'm on you.
My talons dig into your shoulder.
This slam throws you back.
I stomp and the ground cracks.
My wings blast wind in your face.
You stagger backwards.
My beak raps your armor.
My talons hit hard.
I land and your legs buckle.
Three lines are left on you.
I raise a talon and bring it down.
I break out of the clouds.
My wings settle on the ridge.
The rock rings under my weight.
The wind is strong enough; I'll stay.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，雪从羽毛上落。
lines.en: I shake and snow falls from my feathers.
The sun is warm on my back.
Half eagle, half lion, on the cliff edge.
Someone below just looked up.
I fold my wings and survey the land.
My first cry echoes off the valley.

lines.zh: 羽毛被燎焦了，味很难闻。
lines.en: My feathers are singed; the smell is awful.

lines.zh: 摔下来不疼，我天生抗摔。
lines.en: The plunge doesn't hurt; I'm built for it.
Water is too heavy; I flounder and sink.
The blast sends me tumbling.
An arrow is lodged at my wing's base.
The light makes my feathers tingle.
Too hungry to fly now.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，浑身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back, and I shudder.
No sky below — only nothing.
